title: New City Building Finance Discussion
summary:
*   **Future City Infrastructure:** Council members held a work session focused on the financing plans for a new Municipal Office Complex, indicating discussions around a significant city development project.
*   **Upcoming Business Preview:** The meeting also included a discussion of items scheduled for future council agendas on February 20th and 27th.
*   **Preparatory Meeting:** No city manager reports were presented, and no closed-door executive session was held, suggesting the meeting was primarily for planning and discussion rather than immediate policy actions.

Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council on February 19, 1986, noting the
presence of all Councilmembers. Council held a work session on the Municipal Office
Complex-Finance and discussion of February 20 and February 27, 1986 agenda items.
Council did not hear the City Manager Reports as listed on the agenda, nor did they hold
an executive session.
The meeting was adjourned at 6:30 p.m.
